comment: INF-P3-T01 feature registry (L1). Source of truth: Include/Features.mqh (FeaturesRow), written at the decision time (first tick after range end). as_of = the latest data a value may use. offline = can the INF-P3-T03 builder reproduce it from M1/H1/D1 bars + the calendar snapshot. Version bumps when a definition changes. v2 (INF-P3-T03): spread_avg_pt and cost_pct marked offline=false: the tester derives bar spreads from real ticks, and the broker-stored M1 spread differs (EURUSD-NY parity 77 %); training uses the EA values for these two.

features.name: atr_pct
features.definition: Range (hi - lo over the range window) / previous completed D1 ATR(14) x 100 (engine value)

features.name: cost_pct
features.definition: (average range-window spread + commission) / range x 100 (engine value). Not reproducible from stored M1 bars (tick-derived spread in the tester)

features.name: spread_avg_pt
features.definition: Mean M1 spread over the range window (engine value). Not reproducible from stored M1 bars (tick-derived spread in the tester)

features.name: spread_live_pt
features.definition: Live tick spread at the decision tick; not in bar data

features.name: vol_pct
features.definition: Share of the last 500 completed H1 ATR(20) values <= the latest one

features.name: trend_side
features.definition: Previous completed D1 close vs its SMA(20): +1 above, -1 below, 0 equal

features.name: range_atr
features.definition: atr_pct / 100

features.name: gap_atr
features.definition: (M1 open at range start - previous D1 close) / ATR

features.name: pre_drift_atr
features.definition: (M1 open at range start - M1 open 60 min earlier) / ATR

features.name: range_pos_prev
features.definition: (range midpoint - previous D1 low) / previous D1 range

features.name: brk_prev_high
features.definition: Range high > previous D1 high

features.name: brk_prev_low
features.definition: Range low < previous D1 low

features.name: inside_prev
features.definition: Previous D1 bar inside the one before it

features.name: outside_prev
features.definition: Previous D1 bar outside the one before it

features.name: nr4
features.definition: Previous D1 range is the narrowest of the last 4 completed D1 bars

features.name: nr7
features.definition: Previous D1 range is the narrowest of the last 7 completed D1 bars

features.name: sma_dist_hi_atr
features.definition: (range high - D1 SMA(20) of the previous completed bar) / ATR

features.name: sma_dist_lo_atr
features.definition: (range low - D1 SMA(20) of the previous completed bar) / ATR

features.name: dow
features.definition: Exchange-local day of week

features.name: ev_tier1_entry
features.definition: High-impact events (InpAosEventCcy) scheduled from range start to entry end. Caveat: the calendar file was exported after the fact, so a rescheduled release is hindsight

features.name: ev_tier1_hold
features.definition: High-impact events scheduled from range end to the session exit (same caveat)

features.name: ev_next_min
features.definition: Minutes from range end to the next high-impact event within 24 h (same caveat)

features.name: ev_first_hold
features.definition: Name of the first high-impact event in the hold (same caveat)

features.name: opex
features.definition: Third Friday of the month

features.name: quad_witching
features.definition: Third Friday of Mar / Jun / Sep / Dec

features.name: ctx1_sym
features.definition: Context symbol 1 (InpAosCtxSymbols)

features.name: ctx1_prevday_atr
features.definition: Context symbol's last completed D1 close-to-close move / its D1 ATR(14)

features.name: ctx1_lookback_atr
features.definition: Context symbol's move over InpAosCtxHours into range start (completed M5 closes) / its D1 ATR

features.name: ctx2_sym
features.definition: Context symbol 2

features.name: ctx2_prevday_atr
features.definition: As ctx1_prevday_atr for symbol 2

features.name: ctx2_lookback_atr
features.definition: As ctx1_lookback_atr for symbol 2

features.name: ctx3_sym
features.definition: Context symbol 3

features.name: ctx3_prevday_atr
features.definition: As ctx1_prevday_atr for symbol 3

features.name: ctx3_lookback_atr
features.definition: As ctx1_lookback_atr for symbol 3
